title: The Letter of the Fens
author: Elodie Thackeray
blurb: Marguerite Okonkwo, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
